newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: MeesPierson sees higher 1996 op result.
newsitem.headline: MeesPierson sees higher 1996 op result.

text.p: MeesPierson, the merchant bank which is moving from ABN AMRO to Dutch/Belgian group Fortis, reiterated on Friday it expects a higher 1996 operating result than in 1995.
"The (current) second half figure will be less than in the first half, but over the whole year the operating result will be better than in 1995," chairman Joost Kuiper told reporters.
MeesPierson said in August it expected 1996 operating profit to exceed the 182 million guilders made in 1995. 1995 net profit came in at 250 million guilders.
Net profit in the 1996 first half was 132 million guilders.
Earlier on Friday, Fortis, jointly owned by Dutch group Fortis Amev and Belgian's Fortis AG, said it sealed the MeesPierson takeover for 2.5 billion guilders ($1.43 billion).
The deal was first signalled in a letter of intent on October 4.
